gameDescriptionHtml:
HOST YOUR FOOTBALL
An economic strategy where top football clubs entrust you with organizing their matches. Build in the city, manage its structures and stadium, provide entertainment, food, and security for fans. Your success is measured by Match Readiness.

TAKE CONTROL OF AN AUTHENTIC CITY
Organize matches in three distinct, real-world cities, recognizable by their landmarks and legendary stadiums.

  • “PGE Narodowy” Stadium in WARSAW
  • Maracanã in RIO DE JANEIRO
  • Olympiastadion in BERLIN

PARTNERSHIP WITH LICENSED CLUBS
Legendary clubs like Borussia Dortmund, oOympique de MarseilleBeşiktaş JK, Clube de Regatas do Flamengo, Arsenal FC and FC Bayern München – each with unique philosophy, traditions, and fan culture – entrust you with taking care of their supporters. Each club brings its own traditions, chants, and territorial decorations that transform city districts into true football kingdoms. Your ability to honour these traditions while maintaining order will determine your reputation in the football world. Remember that both fans and media will loudly comment on your actions – from tweets and social media posts to statements from supporter group representatives and articles in the sports press.

ADAPT THE CITY
Copa CIty introduces a completely new dimension of sports gaming – organising major football events. Step into the role of a City Captain and take control of everything that happens off the field. Build infrastructure, manage logistics, and create an unforgettable football celebration long before the first whistle. Welcome to a world where details matter and every decision has consequences. Easy to jump into for football enthusiasts, yet offering an immersive and engaging experience – perfect relaxation even for strategy veterans, though without the micromanagement of typical tycoon games.

MASTER THE FAN EXPERIENCE
Build specialised infrastructure modules that create synergies and increase your event’s effectiveness. Develop public transport networks connecting city districts and transform strategic locations into specialised fan zones inspired by and modelled after real sporting events. Manage urban spaces to satisfy visiting fans while also considering the needs of local residents, who aren’t always happy about the football invasion.

MAKE MONEY AND BUILD HYPE
Attract multiple fan groups with different priorities through marketing campaigns and strategically position them throughout the city districts. Each of the three fan types – Ultras, Core Supporters, and Families – has unique needs and expectations that you must meet to achieve maximum Match Readiness – the key to your success as a host and an organiser.

BRING FANS TO THE STADIUM
On the days preceding the match, your city comes alive! Fan zones fill with team colours, from ultras’ graffiti and club flags to the carnival atmosphere of family areas. Fans bring their club colours to the streets, with authentic behaviours and real-time reactions – from ultras’ flare displays to family pre-match celebrations and traditional club chants. When thousands of supporters flow through meticulously planned routes and security checkpoints, you’ll begin to feel the incredible satisfaction of an organiser. And the greatest reward will be the deafening roar of the stands as players walk onto the perfectly prepared stadium pitch.
